NOTE: Generated from the compiled patch bundle by ./gradlew generatePatchesList. Regenerate this file when preparing a release; do not edit patch entries by hand.

patches.name: Custom fonts
patches.description: Adds separate private TTF/OTF imports for native app text and reader text in Settings > Patch controls.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Analytics
patches.description: Deactivates Firebase Analytics collection in this build. Other trackers, anti-tamper reports and reading statistics stay unchanged. Repatch to restore collection; this is not ban protection.

patches.name: Disable reader reward timer
patches.description: Adds a switch to hide the reader's corner widget and stop its timer. Reading rewards from this timer stop while disabled.

patches.name: GmsCore support (MicroG)
patches.description:
Routes Google Play Services calls through MicroG instead of real GPS.

Works for: Google apps (YouTube, Maps, News, Photos) and third-party apps using classic Google Sign-In (Android 13 and below).

Does not work for: Android 14+ Credential Manager sign-in (most modern third-party apps), Play Integrity / SafetyNet checks, or apps with custom auth.

Requires MicroG RE installed. Apply with Original app certificate patch.

options.title: MicroG package name
options.description: Which MicroG / GmsCore app is installed on your device. Check your device's app list for "MicroG" or "GmsCore" if unsure — most users should leave this as the default.

options.title: Main activity class (optional)
options.description: The app's main Activity class name ending with a semicolon, e.g. /MainActivity; Used to inject the MicroG check at startup. Leave blank for auto-detection.

options.title: Custom package name (optional)
options.description: Rename the app to this package name. Leave blank to keep the original. Must be a valid package name (e.g. com.example.myapp).

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides the launch splash promotion, bottom-bar campaign button, reader bottom banner, chapter-end ad, Library promoted book and daily recommendation. Opt-in rewarded ads stay available.

patches.name: Hide popups
patches.description: Hides promotional and nag popups: home campaign popups and floating banners, the automatic check-in modal, notification permission nags, automatic rating prompts and the popups shown when leaving the reader. Adds a separate switch for the full-screen Featured Works page. Purchase and login dialogs are left as they are.

patches.name: Main navigation controls
patches.description: Adds persistent reorder and show/hide controls for the main bottom tabs. Opens Library at launch when Featured is hidden. Keeps Library, Profile and native Writing availability intact.

patches.name: Material You colors
patches.description: Adds wallpaper-based native app colors and a separate reader page/text palette on Android 12+. Preserves saved reader presets and layouts.

patches.name: Provide Original app certificate
patches.description: Automatically reads the signing certificate from the APK you are patching — no original app installed or file provided needed. Only fill the options below if you are patching an APK that was already re-signed (e.g. a previously patched build): in that case point to the original APK file, or enter the certificate manually.

options.title: Path to original APK (if uninstalled)
options.description: Full path to the original APK or .apks bundle. Example: /sdcard/Download/Waze.apks

options.title: Certificate SHA-1 (manual)
options.description: 40-char hex. Found on APKMirror under app signature info.

options.title: Certificate Base64 DER (manual)
options.description: Needed only for Signature spoof patch. Get it with: apksigner verify --print-certs original.apk

patches.name: Spoof app signature
patches.description:
Makes the app think its signing certificate is unchanged after Morphe re-signs it.

Useful when an app crashes or shows a tamper warning because it checks its own certificate.

Does not bypass Play Integrity / SafetyNet hardware attestation.

Apply with Original app certificate patch.

options.title: Package name override (optional)
options.description: Leave blank — read automatically from the app. Only set this if you changed the app's package name and the patch is using the wrong one.

patches.name: WebNovel GmsCore compatibility
patches.description: Adapts WebNovel's Google SDK availability check and sign-in protocol for GmsCore. Explains a missing GmsCore provider and failed Google sign-in instead of failing silently. Includes the required signature and GmsCore patches. Requires installed app.revanced.android.gms.
